title: Trove reading highlight
description: One line of reading/<source>/highlights/YYYY-MM.jsonl: a highlighted passage or annotation, with its parent document referenced inline. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local time the highlight was made / added

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

guid.description: source-unique id, the dedupe key (Readwise/Hypothesis annotation id, or hash(title,location,added) for Kindle clippings)

text.description: the highlighted passage (omitted for bookmarks / capped clippings)
examples: Attention is the rarest and purest form of generosity.

note.description: the user's annotation / note on the passage

url.description: parent page URL, for web annotations

location.description: page / Kindle location range / position / CFI / in-episode timestamp

color.description: highlight color, where the source has one

extra.description: everything source-specific (AI summary, group id, category, highlighted_at, clipping-limit flag, …)
